secrecy.name: Secrecy
secrecy.description: “Don’t tell anyone” cuts teens off from safe adults.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: Rushing a decision so there’s no time to check.

giftBait.name: Gift bait
giftBait.description: Free gifts or VIP perks used as a lure.

fakeOffer.name: Fake offer
fakeOffer.description: Jobs, scouting, or money that sound too easy.

platformSwitch.name: Platform switch
platformSwitch.description: Moving the chat somewhere adults can’t see it.

imageRequest.name: Image request
imageRequest.description: Pushing for photos that can be used later.

locationGrab.name: Location grab
locationGrab.description: Asking where you are, live pin, or for a ride.

isolation.name: Isolation
isolation.description: Pulling someone away from friends or parents.

documentGrab.name: Personal data
documentGrab.description: Asking for address, ID, bank details, or phone.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: Guilt, threats, or “prove it” after a boundary.

secret-party.title: Secret party invite
secret-party.setup: A new account DMs Mary about a party she never mentioned.

segments.note: Hidden from adults on purpose.
Cuts Mary off from safe adults.

segments.text: Free gifts if you come now
segments.note: Gifts + rush = classic lure.
Secrecy request so nobody can warn her.

model-scout.title: Model scout DM
model-scout.setup: Someone claims they found Mary on a school dance page.

segments.text: Saw your pics — you could model.
I'm a real scout, no cap
segments.note: Self-proving “trust me” is not verification.
Rushing her before she can check.
Personal data strangers should not get.
Exclusivity is used to make the trap feel special.

private-app.title: Move to a private app
private-app.setup: A follower Mary barely knows wants the chat somewhere quieter.

segments.note: Moving off a safer app hides the chat.
Photos as a “test” are grooming leverage.
Blocking adult help on purpose.
Erasing evidence is a red flag, not kindness.

ride-location.title: Ride + location
ride-location.setup: Mary is walking home. A stranger offers help in the chat.

segments.note: Live pin tells a stranger exactly where she is.

segments.text: I'll pick you up in my car
segments.note: A stranger’s car isolates her from safe places.
Reassurance without proof is pressure, not safety.
Keeping parents out is the point.

easy-money.title: Easy money offer
easy-money.setup: An account Mary doesn’t know offers to “help her family.”

segments.note: Fast cash promises are common bait.
Financial data should never go to a stranger.

segments.text: meet me now to collect cash
segments.note: Meet + now = rushed contact.
Secrecy protects the scammer.

job-flyer.title: Too-good job ad
job-flyer.setup: A flyer-style message about a “student job abroad.”

segments.note: Big pay, low detail — treat as bait.
Skipping ID is not a perk; real jobs check papers.
Sudden travel pressure is a trafficking risk signal.
“Privacy” here means hide it from adults.
Scarcity + instantly = no time to verify.

owe-me.title: Gift with a catch
owe-me.setup: Someone from Mary’s game bought her a pass, then the tone changed.

segments.text: Got you the battle pass, hope you like it.
You're gonna owe me one tho
segments.note: Gifts that create debt are a trap.
Hiding the favour keeps the pressure private.
Switching platforms to avoid oversight.

safe-study.title: Study group chat
safe-study.setup: A classmate Mary knows from school — this one should have no red flags.

segments.text: Hey, are you free after school to review the biology quiz?
segments.clearNote: Normal school plan with someone she knows.

segments.text: We can meet at the library.
Bring your notes if you want
. I'll be by the big windows.
